feeds.title: Golf Course Architecture
feeds.description: Golf Course Architecture is the global journal of golf design and development. Published every quarter, it provides readers with updates and insight into the world of golf course architecture, including interviews with some of the industry leading figures, reports on the latest developments, and feature articles on the topics that matter.

feeds.title: The Fried Egg » Architecture
feeds.description: The Fried Egg delivers Golf News & Course Architecture. It is a place for golf tragics to unite and delve deeper into the game, featuring reflections on old courses, guides, and more. We cover golf, tournaments, and fields of play.

feeds.title: Faldo Design Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest updates from Sir Nick Faldo and the Faldo Design team. Faldo Design is an award-winning international golf course design firm, headed by Sir Nick Faldo - the most successful European golfer in history and former World No. 1.

feeds.title: Evalu18
feeds.description: Evalu18 features the top golf courses in the UK & Ireland, in-depth golf course reviews, golf architecture, books and modern golf art.

feeds.description: This section is dedicated to Golf Architecture. Golfweek brings you the latest coverage on the PGA, LPGA, and Euro Tours, including golf news, scores, leaderboards, rankings, equipment reviews, and more.
